name: H04_corsair_captain_buffs_only_your_other_pirates
note: Corsair Captain: 'Other Pirates you control get +1/+1.' The Captain is on the battlefield with P0's Pirate (2/2 -> 3/3), P0's non-Pirate Bear (stays 2/2), the opponent's Pirate (stays 2/2), and the Captain itself (2/2, 'other'). When the Captain leaves, the buff goes with it.
